SMALL BUSINESS MARKETING STRATEGIES

Being a starter, you should be smart enough to represent your business’s prospective clients. Competition is high and clients should consider you competent for the assigned responsibility. Where you have just now started. At least, you should be equipped with the following –

01. Smart & Attractive Business Card, which clients will keep in their pocket for the future.

02. Well-maintained Facebook page with images and posts related to your services.

03.  A google my business page with tel and services information. This should be more visible in respective ZIP codes so that people can find you when they search with the KEYWORD near me.  This should be well maintained, customised, and  with couple of reviews.

04. At least a single-page website with services information and contact details. This may have a form for an appointment or placing information for a FREE consultation so that you can reach them.

05. If possible two-door magnets at your Car/ truck so that people can see your business info and call you.

Nationwide support for LOGO IN HOURS LLC Clients Only

Don't worry for Budget- We will take care you.

The Total Cost of the ABOVE STARTER Package is $500.00. You pay 250.00 in the first month. 250 in the second month.

01. 500 pcs, Smart quality, Business Card.
02.  Two-month FREE support for Google My Business Page. ( Regular Price 150 per month)
03. Free Domain + Hosting [1 year] for Website
04. LIVE Website in 5 days.
05. Two standard-size car magnets.
06. Submission of the website in Google for Indexing. 

All our supports are to make you establish in business. Once you are growing, you may upgrade your website and ask us to continue to google my business page maintenance as it is generating calls. 

Still Have Questions?

Don’t hesitate to reach out to us anytime
